verdict.rationale: Bento's marketing page says every release is scored against production history "offline, in CI, and on live traffic" to catch regressions (docs-14), and its CLI is documented as usable from CI (docs-30). However, the evidence never documents how to configure a CI eval run or how its results would block a deployment. The shadow-mode graduation in docs-12 covers promoting fixes on live traffic, not CI deploy gates, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented CI eval setup (e.g., CI action or eval CLI command), explicit pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for gating deployments, eval dataset definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.
